add_items.title: Add Items
add_items.description: Loot table with items to add to the player's inventory upon successful interaction.

defaultSnippets.label: Entity AddItemsData
defaultSnippets.description: Loot table with items to add to the player's inventory upon successful interaction.

admire.title: Admire
admire.description: If true, the mob that's interacted with will try to do an admire action after interaction. For this to be successful the mob has to have an Admire component and an Admire goal in place.

barter.title: Barter
barter.description: If true, the mob that's interacted with will try to do a barter action after interaction. For this to be successful the mob has to have a Barter component and a Barter goal in place.

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Time in seconds before this entity can be interacted with again.

cooldown_after_being_attacked.title: Cooldown After Being Attacked
cooldown_after_being_attacked.description: Time in seconds before this entity can be interacted with after being attacked.

drop_item_slot.title: Drop Item Slot
drop_item_slot.description: The entity's slot to remove and drop the item from, if any, upon successful interaction. Inventory slots are denoted by positive numbers. Equipment slots are denoted by 'slot.weapon.mainhand', 'slot.weapon.offhand', 'slot.armor.head', 'slot.armor.chest', 'slot.armor.legs', 'slot.armor.feet' and 'slot.armor.body'.

drop_item_y_offset.title: Drop Item y Offset
drop_item_y_offset.description: Will offset the item drop position this amount in the y direction. Requires "drop_item_slot" to be specified.

equip_item_slot.title: Equip Item Slot
equip_item_slot.description: The entity's slot to equip the item to, if any, upon successful interaction. Inventory slots are denoted by positive numbers. Equipment slots are denoted by 'slot.weapon.mainhand', 'slot.weapon.offhand', 'slot.armor.head', 'slot.armor.chest', 'slot.armor.legs', 'slot.armor.feet' and 'slot.armor.body'.

give_item.title: Give Item
give_item.description: If true, the mob that's interacted with will try to replace its current main-hand item with the interactable item after interaction.

health_amount.title: Health Amount
health_amount.description: The amount of health this entity will recover or lose when interacting with this item. Negative values will harm the entity.

hurt_item.title: Hurt Item
hurt_item.description: The amount of damage the item will take when used to interact with this entity. A value of 0 means the item won't lose durability.

interact_text.title: Interact Text
interact_text.description: Text to show when the player is able to interact in this way with this entity when playing with touch-screen controls.

on_interact.title: Interact
on_interact.description: Event to fire when the interaction occurs.

defaultSnippets.label: Entity ActorDefinitionTrigger
defaultSnippets.description: Triggers an entity event when specified conditions are met. Events activate component groups that change entity behavior—transforming villagers into zombie villagers, switching mobs to aggressive mode, or triggering growth stages. Combine with filters to create conditional state machines that respond to gameplay.

particle_on_start.title: Particle On Start
particle_on_start.description: Particle effect that will be triggered at the start of the interaction.

defaultSnippets.label: Entity InteractParticleData
defaultSnippets.description: Particle effect that will be triggered at the start of the interaction.

play_sounds.title: Play Sounds
play_sounds.description: List of sounds to play when the interaction occurs.

repair_entity_item.title: Repair Entity Item
repair_entity_item.description: Allows to repair one of the entity's items.

defaultSnippets.label: Entity RepairEntityItemData
defaultSnippets.description: Allows to repair one of the entity's items.

spawn_entities.title: Spawn Entities
spawn_entities.description: List of entities to spawn when the interaction occurs.

spawn_items.title: Spawn Items
spawn_items.description: Loot table with items to drop on the ground upon successful interaction.

defaultSnippets.label: Entity SpawnItemsData
defaultSnippets.description: Loot table with items to drop on the ground upon successful interaction.

swing.title: Swing
swing.description: If true, the player will do the 'swing' animation when interacting with this entity.

take_item.title: Take Item
take_item.description: If true, the mob that's interacted with will try to replace its current main-hand item with an empty item, and its current main-hand item will occupy the empty selected slot of the player.

transform_to_item.title: Transform To Item
transform_to_item.description: The item used will transform to this item upon successful interaction. Format: itemName:auxValue

use_item.title: Use Item
use_item.description: If true, the interaction will use an item.

vibration.title: Vibration
vibration.description: Vibration to emit when the interaction occurs.
